title: Integrate group cache into LIST ACTIVE and GROUP handlers
description:
Modify the LIST ACTIVE and GROUP command handlers to consult the group cache before hitting SQLite. Cache hit: return cached metadata. Cache miss: query SQLite, populate cache, return result. Artifact: modifications to reader/src/session/commands/list.rs and group.rs.

Acceptance: LIST ACTIVE response time under 5ms for 1000 groups after cache warm-up; GROUP response time under 1ms after cache warm-up; cache miss latency same as current (SQLite query)
